Cada código --sref elige al azar (siempr: Each --sref code randomly picks (always the same ones for the same code) styles from the list of each model's Style Code pack and mixes them with weights; several codes mix with each other (--sref 123 456::0.5) and --sref random picks one. --sw 100 is the node's strength 1.5. Only applies to Imagine and Image prompt, not to edits.
Texto → vídeo, Animar, fotograma final y: Text → video, Animate, end frame and loop use the fl2va model with its Pika Flex LoRA; with references, ref2va with its own. Always with Pika's sigmas and lcm, with audio, and the prompt is written by the enhancer (MiniMax's official video guide) once per job.
A local LLM writes and edits the prompt. For each message ComfyUI's models are unloaded, the GGUF loads in a separate process and that process ends when it answers, so no memory stays in use. While it answers no generations start, and it doesn't answer while the ComfyUI queue is working.
Cada segmento con peso se aplica con el: Each weighted segment is applied with each model's concept slider (MiniMaxH3ConceptSlider, MOSSConceptSlider, AnimaTagSlider), chained after --sref.
attention: cuánto atiende la imagen al c: attention: how much the image attends to the concept
weight_norm: escala el concepto mantenie: weight_norm: scales the concept keeping its magnitude
